[image: Border Security]Border SecurityTexas cannot wait on Washington. Jenn treats border security as a constitutional public-safety duty — and an active front against cartel-terrorist warfare.Read more

[image: Data Centers and Infrastructure]Data Centers and InfrastructureTexas can welcome responsible digital infrastructure — on Texas terms. Companies that build here must never infringe on the Bill of Rights of "We the People"—whose rights are superior to those of corporations—and must carry their own grid and water burden, respect landowners, and operate transparently. We must also ask: What is the limit that our grid and water will bear? Government exists to protect the people’s rights to their property and liberty.Read more

[image: Education & Parents]Education & ParentsThe founders knew that self-government only works if power over your children's upbringing rests first with you — not a distant institution, and not a state agency answering to no one. This isn't a funding problem — it's a discipline and accountability problem. Jenn's plan is built on a simple standard: schools teach reading, writing, math, science, and honest history — and parents raise their kids.Read more

[image: Faith & Family]Faith & FamilyFaith. Family. Freedom. Jenn calls her campaign a Reformation Revolution — a call for churches, families, and everyday Texans to step back into leadership.Read more

[image: Foreign Interests]Foreign InterestsTexas will be Texas first. Jenn will defend Texas sovereignty, security, land, and liberties against foreign interests that put outside powers ahead of Texans.Read more

[image: Healthcare]HealthcareTexans are waiting weeks for basic appointments, paying more every year for insurance that covers less, and footing the bill for state programs that extend to people without legal status. Meanwhile, outdated supervision rules keep qualified NPs and PAs from practicing to the level of their training. This is a system problem, built on regulations and middlemen that answer to no one. Jenn's plan: Expand access. Cut the cost drivers. Protect Texas taxpayers and Texas values — without raising taxes, and without compromising on life or asking Texas taxpayers to foot a bigger bill.Read more
[image: Property Tax and Government Spend]Property Tax and Government SpendProperty taxes hit every Texan — regardless of party — and they're one of the defining issues of this election.Read more

[image: Texas Sovereignty]Texas SovereigntyTexas first — always. Jenn signed the Texas First Pledge and will defend Texas land, communities, and government from federal overreach and foreign influence.Read more
